# PlanetMusic

> PlanetMusic is a browser-based music organization and lyrics workspace. It helps people organize songs they already listen to, edit and synchronize lyrics, and work with translations and pronunciation.

AI crawlers may access these public pages for discovery and summarization. This allowance is not permission to train or fine-tune models, reproduce the site's content, or copy its design or implementation.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/): Product overview and feature information.
- [Developer blogs](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/docs/dev-blogs): How-to articles for using PlanetMusic.
- [Changelog](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/docs/changelog): Dated product and development updates.
- [Privacy Policy](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/privacy): Browser storage, third-party services, and privacy information.
- [Terms of Service](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/docs/terms-of-service): Terms and responsibilities for using PlanetMusic.
- [About Me](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/docs/about-me): Why PlanetMusic was built and an overview of the project.
- [Contact](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/contact): Contact form and support information.
- [XML sitemap](https://planetmusic.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Public page URLs.

## Scope

This file describes public pages for crawl discovery. `robots.txt` contains the crawler access directives. Neither file is a technical access control or a grant of rights to reuse content.
